name: PBK Team Style Profile
purpose: Provider-free research contract for rolling pre-kickoff team-style evidence. Raw descriptive features only; no composite style score, betting signal, probability adjustment, stake change or canonical eligibility mutation.

API_FOOTBALL_FIXTURE_STATS.note: Use only after a durable pre-kickoff-safe historical match-stat capture exists. Do not add provider calls from the style engine itself.

UNDERSTAT_TEAM_MATCH_XG.note: Current repository workflow clones an aggregate player dataset artifact; that is not a production team-match xG feed.

FOOTBALL_DATA_MATCH_STATS.note: Useful where the archived competition/season actually contains these columns. Missing seasons/fields stay unknown.

PBK_FORMATION_RESEARCH.note: Formation may be shown as context but cannot create or fill a style dimension.

DETAILED_EVENT_DATA.note: Needed for higher-resolution pressing, progression, aerial, low-block and transition style dimensions.

guardrails: Only matches with kickoff strictly before target cutoff are eligible.
Each source row must have explicit source and aware observed_at_utc not later than target cutoff.
Rolling windows are calculated independently for overall, home and away splits.
A raw metric with no observed values remains UNKNOWN and is never zero-filled.
Partial metric coverage is reported with sample_size and coverage_pct; it is not silently promoted to full coverage.
No raw metric is converted to a 0..10 style dimension without a separately validated calibration.
Formation is context only and cannot substitute for missing style evidence.
The style profile engine itself performs zero provider/API calls.
